mcat_description.short: Portable Dressing Room is a prefabricated, relocatable cabin-style enclosure used as a changing or trial room in retail shops, garment stores, swimming pools, events, and construction sites. Sold as a complete unit (per piece), it is constructed from materials such as GI, mild steel, HPL compact board, FRP, or PVC panels on a structural frame.
mcat_description.long: A Portable Dressing Room is a factory-built, self-contained changing enclosure that can be transported to site and installed without civil construction work. In the Indian B2B market, the dominant commercial form is a modular cabin made from GI or mild steel framing with HPL compact board, FRP, or colour-coated sandwich panel walls, sized typically between 3x3 ft and 6x6 ft for retail trial rooms and up to 8x10 ft for event or poolside use. These units are sold primarily to garment retailers, boutique owners, event organisers, swimming pool operators, and construction contractors who need a private changing space without permanent infrastructure. Key buyer-valued features include material durability, ease of relocation, customisable dimensions, interior fittings (mirror, hook, curtain rod), and weather resistance for outdoor deployments.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Portable Dressing Room' is used interchangeably with 'trial room', 'changing room cabin', and 'portable changing room' — with 'trial room for shop' being the highest-intent buyer search phrase. The product sits within the broader prefabricated/porta cabin industry and is manufactured primarily in Delhi-NCR, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Chennai. Two structurally distinct product families exist under this name: (1) prefabricated structural cabins made from GI, mild steel, HPL compact board, FRP, or PVC panels — the dominant B2B commercial form — and (2) lightweight curtain-and-frame units (metal rod frame + blackout fabric) sold to individual boutique owners and photographers. The structural cabin segment serves retail garment stores, swimming pools, events, and construction sites; it is customisable in size, material, and interior fittings. Key differentiating specs buyers compare include material type, cabin dimensions, built type (modular vs. prefab), and interior accessories (mirror, hook, curtain rod). Sellers are concentrated in metro manufacturing hubs and supply pan-India; some export to Gulf countries (single source — low confidence for export claim).
